20 hours of its exercise, an hour a day, would take it from 61 to about 64. On your recent work, judged again as you are now, that’s forecast to be worth about 0.7 points a piece (your last piece calls on it; The Second Answer (The God Speaks Through Her), Taped would gain most, about +0.5). Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old.
